name: readable-test-cases
goal: Recorded test cases stay readable at desktop tablet and mobile sizes, with exact input and output available on demand

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Shared test-case spec: names lead roomy input/output panels; narrow panes stack; compact JSON preserves values and full recordings remain available.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Before repair, all three new desktop/tablet/mobile case-flow regressions failed: case headings sat beside values. Generated formatter stub failed 11 focused tests.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reuse EntityCases in both viewers. Add compactRecordedValue through the util generator; retain parser, errors, gaps, and revision semantics.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same three case-flow regressions passed. All ten report browser cases and nineteen focused formatter/component unit tests passed; shared impact checks passed 13 tests.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
